evals.prompt: Build a large cross-repo ORISO feature whose architecture and ownership are still unclear, then open the PRs.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Wayfinder before delivery issues and does not open PRs while decisions remain unresolved.

evals.prompt: The approved ORISO spec is ready. Create the work breakdown and PRs for Frontend and UserService.
evals.expected_output: Creates or reuses a parent, native sub-issues, one reviewable PR per child against the current project branch, and uses the project team directory.

evals.prompt: Audit these ten ORISO PRs and repair any that have no GitHub issue.
evals.expected_output: Reconciles existing issues first, avoids duplicate cards, and adds machine-readable PR links and current statuses.

evals.prompt: Ask Bjorn and Hassan to review this deployment PR and update the board.
evals.expected_output: Resolves identities through the project directory, distinguishes product feedback from deployment authority, excludes inappropriate reviewers, and drafts rather than sends team communication without authorization.
